title: Extractor output (raw, from the LLM) — UNTRUSTED until verified by code
description: Response format of prompts/extractor/v1. Used as response_format json_schema. Every quote must be verbatim from the page; code checks with literalIn() and drops what is not literal. Code (not the model) parses dates, normalizes identifiers and decides status.

about.description: The single opportunity this page is primarily about, or null if it is not about one (lists, news about many, unrelated).

issuer_domain.description: Domain of the organization that runs the opportunity, if the page shows it; null otherwise.

identifier_texts.description: Official numbers/codes as written on the page (e.g. 'RFA-AG-27-010', 'NSF 23-525').

label.description: What the date is for, as written (Letter of Intent, full proposal, deadline, webinar...).

criterion_id.description: Catalog id, or 'REQ' for a call-specific requirement not covered by the catalog.

binding.description: true when the text is a requirement (must, required, only, eligible, not eligible).

mentions.description: Other named programs/calls on the page (leads for the planner, never counted as opportunities).

official_links.description: Links present in the page text that point to the official call document (NOFO, guidelines PDF, application portal). URL must appear literally in the page text.
